parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: HpcClusterIds
parameters.description: The IDs of HPC clusters. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 HPC cluster IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the HPC cluster list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
